answer: Proof of Stake consensus mitigates Sybil attacks by requiring agents to lock capital as collateral, turning the network into a financial canyon where identity forgery is prohibitively expensive. An attacker attempting to whisper fake validation signals must possess vast wealth, a barrier as imposing as a glacial glacier that forces rational actors to behave honestly to protect their locked assets. This economic cost ensures that the network remains resilient against cheap, automated sybil multiplication.
